title: Which of these return a dangling reference

prereqs.why: A reference is a name for something that already exists; the question is whether that something is still alive when the name is used.

hints: Ask of each one: what object does the returned thing name, and when is that object destroyed? A `static` lives for the whole program; a parameter that is a reference names something the caller owns; a local does not survive the `return`.

`std::string_view` is a reference in all but name — it holds a pointer and a length into somebody else's characters and owns none of them. The question for D is the same as for B, not the same as for C.
